profiles.name: Fable Vector Rounded
profiles.behavior_notes: Baseline literature tuning; squash-stretch blinks; cartoon saccade overshoot; full idle-act repertoire.

profiles.name: Fable Cozmo Cubic
profiles.behavior_notes: Boxier corners, slightly sparser blinks, stronger overshoot.

profiles.name: Fable RoboEyes Alert
profiles.behavior_notes: Fast blinks, wide wander, shiver (h-flicker) act in the repertoire.

profiles.name: Fable RoboEyes Soft
profiles.behavior_notes: Tired mood lids, slow sparse blinks with lazy reopen, occasional feline slow-blink.

profiles.name: Fable M5 Avatar Classic
profiles.behavior_notes: Small disc eyes with closed-lid line, breathing bob, keyframe-driven mouth.

profiles.name: Fable M5 Avatar Manga
profiles.behavior_notes: Dark irises with glints, expressive brows, wink act enabled.

profiles.name: Fable EVE Minimal
profiles.behavior_notes: Tilted glowing teardrop eyes; expression carried by shape, tilt acts, slow blinks.

profiles.name: Fable Jibo Orb
profiles.behavior_notes: Single cyclops orb; wide gaze travel, squash blink, calm act palette.

profiles.name: Fable Saccade Lab
profiles.behavior_notes: Full oculomotor fidelity: main-sequence darts with physiological undershoot + corrective saccade, microsaccades and drift, gaze-evoked blinks, iris parallax.

profiles.name: Fable Brow Dialogue
profiles.behavior_notes: 1.7x brow gain: arousal posture, speech-emphasis beats, thinking asymmetry, brow-flash and wink acts.

profiles.name: Fable Lid Anticipation
profiles.behavior_notes: 110 ms lid lookahead: lids visibly lead every planned gaze move; slow reopen shows the asymmetric blink envelope.

profiles.name: Fable Iris Parallax
profiles.behavior_notes: Iris travels farther than the eye body; specular highlight pinned to the light; strong microsaccades.

profiles.name: Fable Sleep Wake
profiles.behavior_notes: 45 s doze cycle while idle: droop with startle recoveries, sleep with deep breathing and micro-twitches, fluttering wake; any conversation activity stays alert.

profiles.name: Fable Curious Tilt
profiles.behavior_notes: Whole-face tilt acts (attention head-tilt) with widened eyes; gaze-side eye growth.

profiles.name: Fable Dot Matrix Eyes
profiles.behavior_notes: LED-panel presentation: eye field sampled into 4 px cells with a dim resting grid.

profiles.name: Fable Cat Optics
profiles.behavior_notes: Vertical slit pupils that dilate with arousal, affiliative slow blinks, sparse feline blink rate, undershoot saccades.
